name: Sendspin → Source Set Signal
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions/#all-actions) tells the server whether the [source](https://esphome.io/components/sendspin/#source) has audio to offer. The device reports that it has none until the action first runs. Requires a `source` block.

config_entries.label: Present
config_entries.description: `true` when the source has audio to offer, `false` when it does not.
